rules.text: Order number (GLO#) must be provided to place a return.

rules.text: Exchanges can be processed by contacting customer service or visiting a store within the 30 day return window.
rules.quote: If you don’t see the return option there, or you’d like to process an exchange, please reach out to gTEAM@glossier.com or visit one of our stores with your order number and the products you'd like to exchange or return, and we'll take care of the rest.

rules.text: Gift returns are accepted for store credit only and require the gifter's information to locate the original order.
rules.quote: If you were gifted Glossier but it isn't what you had in mind, you can return your items for store credit. Please reach out to gTEAM@glossier.com or visit one of our stores with the gifter's first and last name, email address, and the products you’d like to return or exchange (the gifter won’t be notified of any changes). Once locating the original order, we'll handle it!

rules.text: Refunds are issued to the original form of payment or as a Glossier gift card if using the self-service returns process.

rules.text: Credit card refunds usually take 5–10 business days to appear on your statement; gift card refunds are available immediately.

rules.text: Returns or exchanges are not accepted for products purchased through wholesale partners like Sephora, Space NK, and Mecca.

rules.text: Returns and exchanges can be processed in-store within 30 days of receiving the order with order number and products.
